extraction.description: The screenshot shows the UiPath Agents evaluations interface on an "Edit evaluator" form. A deterministic "Exact Match" evaluator is configured with the name "Residency Validation Evaluator" and a description explaining that it checks exact string matches. The Name field and Target output fields area are visually highlighted, with the target output set to "ResidencyValidationDecision".
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Name field and enter "Residency Validation Evaluator". Select "Deterministic" in the Category dropdown. Select "Exact Match" in the Type dropdown. In the Target output fields field, enter "ResidencyValidationDecision".
